dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estadistica storm and wind hazard datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estadística: storm and wind hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about storm and wind hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Asalariados temporales por grado de urbanización (Identificador API: 6; Asalariados temporales por comunidad autónoma (Identificador API: 6959; Asalariados temporales por edad (Identificador API: 69602); Asalariados temporales por sexo (Identificador API: 69601). Formats seen: HTML, CSV, SHEET, PC-AXIS, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
